taxonomy.subtopic: Usual interstitial pneumonia, fibroblastic foci, and basal subpleural honeycombing

entries.learning_objective: Differentiate usual interstitial pneumonia from other interstitial patterns by its temporally heterogeneous fibroblastic foci and basal subpleural honeycombing, and connect epithelial injury to profibrotic TGF-beta signaling.
entries.media_spec: Original paired high-resolution CT and histology schematic showing basal peripheral reticulation, traction bronchiectasis, honeycomb cysts, and patchy fibroblastic foci.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets UIP pattern recognition or TGF-beta-driven pulmonary fibrosis.

taxonomy.subtopic: GLUT1-positive proliferative and involution phases

entries.learning_objective: Recognize infantile hemangioma as a benign GLUT1-positive endothelial proliferation that grows after birth and usually involutes, distinguishing it from vascular malformations present at birth.
entries.media_spec: Original age-course diagram with proliferative and involution phases plus a GLUT1-positive endothelial-channel schematic.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers infantile vascular tumors or their natural history.

taxonomy.subtopic: HPV16 E6/E7, p53/RB disruption, and p16 overexpression

entries.learning_objective: Explain why HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous carcinoma shows p16 overexpression through E7-mediated RB inactivation and distinguish it from tobacco-associated field carcinogenesis.
entries.media_spec: Original tonsillar anatomy and molecular pathway schematic linking HPV E6/E7 to p53/RB loss and p16 overexpression.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets HPV-positive oropharyngeal carcinoma.

entries.backend_title: Congenital anomalies of kidney and urinary tract

taxonomy.subtopic: Bladder outlet obstruction, bilateral hydronephrosis, and oligohydramnios

entries.learning_objective: Identify posterior urethral valves as a male fetal bladder-outlet obstruction that causes a distended bladder, bilateral hydroureteronephrosis, oligohydramnios, and pulmonary hypoplasia.
entries.media_spec: Original fetal urinary-tract ultrasound schematic showing dilated bladder, proximal urethra, bilateral hydronephrosis, and low amniotic fluid.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers congenital lower-urinary-tract obstruction.

taxonomy.subtopic: Hapten-specific type IV delayed hypersensitivity

entries.learning_objective: Connect allergic contact dermatitis to hapten modification of skin proteins, Langerhans-cell priming, and memory T-cell-mediated delayed inflammation on re-exposure.
entries.media_spec: Original two-stage sensitization and elicitation diagram with epidermal hapten, dendritic cell, lymph node, and T-cell return to skin.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers contact-allergen hapten biology.

taxonomy.subtopic: Breslow depth and vertical growth as prognostic determinants

entries.learning_objective: Use Breslow thickness to assess melanoma prognosis and distinguish radial growth from invasive vertical growth into the dermis.
entries.media_spec: Original skin cross-section showing radial epidermal spread, vertical dermal invasion, and a Breslow measurement line.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets melanoma depth staging or growth phases.

taxonomy.subtopic: Fanconi syndrome and generalized proximal solute wasting

entries.learning_objective: Localize glucosuria with normal serum glucose, phosphaturia, aminoaciduria, and bicarbonate wasting to generalized proximal-tubule dysfunction.
entries.media_spec: Original nephron map highlighting proximal reabsorption of glucose, phosphate, amino acids, and bicarbonate with urinary-loss arrows.
entries.distinctness_note: Existing nephron drafts focus on loop diuretics and glomerular disease, not generalized proximal transport failure.

taxonomy.subtopic: Malignant osteoid, metaphyseal growth, and RB1 association

entries.learning_objective: Recognize osteosarcoma by metaphyseal destructive bone formation with malignant osteoid and connect risk to RB1 and TP53 pathway defects.
entries.media_spec: Original distal-femur radiograph schematic with sunburst periosteal reaction and Codman triangle plus malignant-osteoid histology.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers primary malignant bone tumors.

taxonomy.subtopic: B-cell infection and reactive CD8-positive atypical lymphocytes

entries.learning_objective: Explain that EBV infects B cells through CD21 while the atypical lymphocytes in peripheral blood are activated cytotoxic T cells responding to infected B cells.
entries.media_spec: Original EBV-B-cell/CD21 and reactive CD8-cell schematic with peripheral-smear morphology.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers EBV mononucleosis cellular immunology.

taxonomy.subtopic: HHV-8 spindle-cell vascular proliferation in immunodeficiency

entries.learning_objective: Recognize Kaposi sarcoma as an HHV-8-associated spindle-cell vascular tumor with slit-like spaces and extravasated erythrocytes in immunodeficiency.
entries.media_spec: Original purple skin-lesion and histology schematic showing spindle cells, vascular slits, and red-cell extravasation.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers HHV-8-associated vascular neoplasia.

taxonomy.subtopic: Articular cartilage loss, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophyte formation

entries.learning_objective: Distinguish osteoarthritis from inflammatory arthritis by focal cartilage degeneration, subchondral sclerosis, osteophytes, and activity-related pain with brief morning stiffness.
entries.media_spec: Original weight-bearing knee radiograph schematic and cartilage cross-section showing asymmetric joint-space loss, sclerosis, and osteophytes.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers degenerative joint pathology.

taxonomy.subtopic: UVB-induced keratinocyte dysplasia and progression to squamous carcinoma

entries.learning_objective: Recognize actinic keratosis as UV-induced atypia confined largely to the lower epidermis and a precursor to cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma.
entries.media_spec: Original sun-exposed skin and histology schematic showing parakeratosis and basal keratinocyte atypia without dermal invasion.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers actinic keratosis or cutaneous SCC precursors.

taxonomy.subtopic: Sarcoptes burrows and delayed hypersensitivity pruritus

entries.learning_objective: Identify scabies from nocturnal pruritus and burrows in interdigital or flexural sites, and explain symptoms as a delayed hypersensitivity response to mites and products.
entries.media_spec: Original epidermal-burrow cross-section with mite, eggs, fecal pellets, and typical hand distribution map.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers ectoparasitic skin disease.

taxonomy.subtopic: Resorption distal to airway obstruction and ipsilateral mediastinal shift

entries.learning_objective: Differentiate obstructive atelectasis from tension physiology by recognizing volume loss and mediastinal shift toward the collapsed lung after bronchial obstruction.
entries.media_spec: Original chest radiograph schematic comparing mucus-plug atelectasis with tension pneumothorax and showing direction of mediastinal shift.
entries.distinctness_note: Prior pneumothorax draft covers pressure and contralateral shift, not resorptive volume loss.

taxonomy.subtopic: TGF-beta-driven collagen deposition beyond original wound boundaries

entries.learning_objective: Distinguish keloids from hypertrophic scars by extension beyond the original wound and persistent excessive collagen deposition driven by fibroblast signaling.
entries.media_spec: Original side-by-side scar cross-section comparing hypertrophic scar confined to the wound with keloid extension beyond its borders.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers abnormal wound-healing scars.

taxonomy.subtopic: C5-C6 injury and Erb-Duchenne posture

entries.learning_objective: Localize loss of shoulder abduction, lateral rotation, elbow flexion, and forearm supination after traction injury to the upper trunk C5-C6.
entries.media_spec: Original brachial-plexus roots-to-branches diagram highlighting the upper trunk and affected muscle actions.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers brachial-plexus localization.

taxonomy.subtopic: Unopposed neutrophil elastase and misfolded hepatic protein retention

entries.learning_objective: Link lower-lobe panacinar emphysema to unopposed neutrophil elastase and liver injury to intracellular retention of misfolded alpha-1 antitrypsin.
entries.media_spec: Original lung lobule and hepatocyte diagram showing panacinar destruction and PAS-positive diastase-resistant globules.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets the dual lung-liver mechanism of alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency.

taxonomy.subtopic: Terminal ileal bile-salt loss, fat malabsorption, and calcium oxalate stones

entries.learning_objective: Explain why terminal-ileal Crohn disease increases calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis through bile-salt malabsorption, free fatty-acid calcium binding, and increased colonic oxalate absorption.
entries.media_spec: Original enterohepatic and intestinal-lumen schematic showing unabsorbed fatty acids binding calcium and free oxalate entering the colon and kidney.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers the enteric-hyperoxaluria complication of Crohn disease.

taxonomy.subtopic: Optic-chiasm compression and bitemporal hemianopia

entries.learning_objective: Localize bitemporal hemianopia from a sellar macroadenoma to compression of crossing nasal retinal fibers at the optic chiasm.
entries.media_spec: Original sellar MRI and visual-pathway diagram highlighting optic-chiasm compression and temporal visual-field loss.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers pituitary mass-effect neuroanatomy.

taxonomy.subtopic: Premature trypsin activation, fat necrosis, and hypocalcemia

entries.learning_objective: Connect premature intrapancreatic trypsin activation to autodigestion, peripancreatic fat necrosis, and calcium soap formation that can lower serum calcium.
entries.media_spec: Original pancreatic acinar activation cascade plus CT-style peripancreatic inflammation and fat-saponification schematic.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets pancreatitis enzyme activation and hypocalcemia.
